title: Convert frmcustomer to C# WinForms
problem_statement: The frmcustomer form is currently implemented in VB6 and needs to be converted to C# to ensure compatibility with modern systems.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology, leading to potential security and maintenance issues.
suggested_approach: Use a C# WinForms template to recreate the UI and logic of the frmcustomer form.
success_criteria: The frmcustomer form is fully functional in C# with all original features preserved.
